systems.tiers: 54 of 92 planned pilot sites fully operational (UNDP, July 2026); equipment going to health districts, departmental directorates and the central level; extension to other health facilities planned after the pilot

systems.country_label: plateforme de collecte des données de santé (Dhis2)
plateformes numériques des Programmes nationaux de lutte contre le VIH/sida (PNLS) et la tuberculose (PNLT)
systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé et de la Population (PNLS, PNLT), with UNDP

note: The systems described are a stock and supply-chain system (single-function) and two programme platforms described only as spreading knowledge and results; DHIS2 is named only as the health data collection platform the e-LMIS is being made interoperable with, with no description of aggregate reporting, so no fact for hmis or emr.
